historical_result_policy: Outputs under v2 are implementation diagnostics and are excluded from confirmatory comparison. V3 changes only the ordering of the already prespecified operational-feasibility and economic objectives.
change_reason: the v2 pilot exposed that a weighted currency penalty could trade a small realized reserve violation against economics
apply the experiment-wide rule operational feasibility first by minimizing expected nonnegative service and SOC slack before the economic objective
because all scenario probabilities are positive, a zero expected feasibility score implies zero modeled slack in every scenario

method.formulation: event-receding two-stage stochastic mixed-integer linear program
method.first_stage: common executable decisions until the next declared information update
method.second_stage: scenario-specific recourse from the first executable interval after that update
method.policy: solve again only when the public uncertainty set changes or the physical outcome becomes causally observable; preserve all already settled intervals
method.physical_model: unchanged app_rt.py bus, trip, charger, SOC, service and V2G model
method.objective: lexicographically minimize probability-weighted service and SOC slack, then optimize mode-aligned expected PTO economics under the same tariffs
method.solver_time_limit_scope: per standalone or lexicographic optimization stage
